sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's entry is compatible with the department's PhD route; complete the UChicago degree before
enrollment. University normally expects at least 3.0 in junior/senior undergraduate work. Math admits
internationally and only for fall; the ordinary Math/Applied Math MS is not a separate entry route. F-1 status is
not academic disqualification; new immigration documentation follows admission. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Contact grad@math.msu.edu about current requirements/fee support; select Mathematics PhD in Slate, supply
junior/senior/graduate mathematics and statistics courses including planned courses, register three referees,
upload the required documents and pay or arrange departmental payment. No prior supervisor agreement is
published. Check the English waiver before omitting a test. [s1] [s5] [s13]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No required pre-application adviser approval found. Shortlist below groups relevant active research faculty;
email targeted research questions only after checking 2027 capacity. Emeriti Hall,Rotthaus,Sagan,Wald are not
ordinary adviser listings; Bell's primary fit was not established in the requested fields. Kulkarni/Magyar current
appointments verified but recent paper coverage remains incomplete. [s15] [s16] [s19] [s22] [s39] [s41]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public illustrated international guide explains Slate account, credentials, referees, supplements, payment and
post-payment uploads. Finalized application information cannot normally be edited; supplementary
CV/documents can be uploaded after payment. No account opened or invitations sent in this research. [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Math deadline/GRE rules are standing, not explicitly labeled Fall 2027. Central UDF is explicitly 2027-28;
ordinary Math funding page is labeled 2025-26 and internally dates its application deadline December 2025.
Current university stipend table covers 2026-27 only. [s1] [s4] [s10] [s12]

postpone the applicant's December file. Hour/timezone unspecified. [s1] [s2] [s12]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not waived, TOEFL taken after January 21, 2026: total4.5, reading/speaking≥4, listening/writing≥4.5; older
TOEFL80 with R/L/S≥19,W≥22. IELTS6.5 with every band≥6. Central PTE53(R/L/S≥51,W≥59) and DET110 also
appear, but Math explicitly names TOEFL/IELTS, so confirm alternatives. Reports valid two years before entry;
do not infer Math accepts provisional English admission. [s1] [s6] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed regular US four-year bachelor's with most credits earned in the US qualifies for automatic
admissions waiver (not an online/experiential/overseas-branch degree). UChicago meets the institutional
setting; confirm handling while the BA is still in progress. A nonautomatic waiver is submitted by the
department. Admission waiver does NOT waive spoken-English TA certification: TOEFL speaking27/5.5, IELTS
speaking8, MSU Speaking Test50, or specified language-course plus oral-test route. [s6] [s9]
GRE General [Standing rule]
REQUIRED by both current department admissions page and FAQ; unofficial report initially, official if admitted;
five-year validity. No published Fall 2027 exception found. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended, not formally required. FAQ warns admission without it is very rare and asks for other
strong mathematical evidence, such as advanced courses or research examples. Do not mistake optional for
indifferent. Five-year validity. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three recommendations, submitted electronically by the writers. Math does not publicly specify a different
mandatory academic/professional mix or maximum. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
UDF nomination adds a JOINT support letter from MSU graduate director and proposed adviser plus their
separate ≤500-word mentoring statement. These are institutional nomination documents, not a fourth external
applicant referee. Other scholarship-specific referee questions unverified. [s12]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
After contact details, access-waiver choice and typed signature, pressing Send to Recommender emails the
submission link. Institutional/corporate email is advised. Merely typing details is not the documented trigger.
[s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before final application submission: the referee step precedes electronic signature and
finalization in the official guide. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Slate provides status checking and a received/awaiting document checklist; check individual recommendations
in the account. A mathematics-specific letter-receipt email or separate referee receipt display was not publicly
demonstrated. [s1] [s14]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Math-specific letter replacement, post-submission writer changes, Interfolio support and reuse across cycles
are not established. The central guide warns finalized application information is immutable; request
instructions from grad@math.msu.edu for corrections. [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Fall 2027 ordinary Math stipend not established. Old department page quotes USD21,990 first year including
conditional summer teaching, and later summer about9000; these are stale, not a 2027 offer. University
2026-27 minimum half-time TA level1 is1162 biweekly; research/teaching-excluded level1 is1028, so
classification matters. Current 2027-28 UDF: approximately 32500 yearly GA base plus10000 annual
fellowship; later department base must match. Ordinary offer needs separate confirmation. [s3] [s4] [s10] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Department promises admitted PhD students assistantship support for five years; sixth may be possible by
need/performance, not guaranteed. First-year teaching reduction is tutoring instead of usual classroom duties.
Summer support is conditional on teaching eligibility and availability, not unconditional year-round funding. [s3]
[s4]
International eligibility [Conflict]
Department support applies to admitted international students; old college and departmental recruitment
awards explicitly include all applicants. Old UDF/UEF page limits eligibility to citizens/permanent residents,

whereas the updated 2027 central UDF criteria publish no citizenship condition. International UDF eligibility
therefore needs explicit clarification before counting the award. [s2] [s4] [s12]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Assistantship renewal requires academic progress and duty performance; TA oral-language certification is
separate from admission. University assistantship benefits:9 tuition credits per fall/spring and5
summer(max23/year), nonresident tuition exemption, student health premium paid; program fees remain.
Fall+spring coverage extends August 16-August 15. Confirm the exact appointment's fees, dependent
premiums and summer contract. [s9] [s11] [s44]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standing Math fellowship consideration is automatic for complete eligible files by December 1. UDF is by
department/college nomination after admission recommendation, not direct student application. Request
confirmation of any 2027 college supplement. [s4] [s12]
Other funding routes [Prior cycle]
Prior-cycle College of Natural Science recruitment fellowship:34000 for first12months, then departmental TA;
departmental recruitment supplement:8000 firstyear. Amounts 2027 unconfirmed. UDF current package
described above; CUMREC considered during UDF process. Seek citizenship-permitted external awards and
summer research/teaching opportunities individually. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD75 shown in central international Slate payment instructions; nonrefundable status not established in the
checked page. Confirm displayed amount for the 2027 application before payment. [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Ask grad@math.msu.edu. Math's GRE-top-half waiver/reimbursement is explicitly for US citizens/permanent
residents, so F-1 alone does not qualify. General fee waivers include McNair/recruitment routes; do not assume
international eligibility. MSU ends BTAA FreeApp participation December 31, 2026. For department-paid
applications, notify the program after final submission so it completes payment. [s1] [s2] [s5] [s13]

Pay attention to
• December 1 fellowship priority precedes January 20 ordinary deadline.
• General GRE required; Math GRE optional but strongly weighted by the published FAQ.

• Two distinct statements are required; actual Math prompts are portal-only in the checked sources.
• UChicago degree waiver does not remove TA spoken-English qualification.
• Current UDF funding is substantially different from the old Math fellowship page; international eligibility
needs clarification.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's entry is compatible with the department's PhD route; complete the UChicago degree before
enrollment. University normally expects at least 3.0 in junior/senior undergraduate work. Math admits
internationally and only for fall; the ordinary Math/Applied Math MS is not a separate entry route. F-1 status is
not academic disqualification; new immigration documentation follows admission. [s1] [s2] [s7] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Contact grad@math.msu.edu about current requirements/fee support; select Mathematics PhD in Slate, supply
junior/senior/graduate mathematics and statistics courses including planned courses, register three referees,
upload the required documents and pay or arrange departmental payment. No prior supervisor agreement is
published. Check the English waiver before omitting a test. [s1] [s5] [s13]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No required pre-application adviser approval found. Shortlist below groups relevant active research faculty;
email targeted research questions only after checking 2027 capacity. Emeriti Hall,Rotthaus,Sagan,Wald are not
ordinary adviser listings; Bell's primary fit was not established in the requested fields. Kulkarni/Magyar current
appointments verified but recent paper coverage remains incomplete. [s15] [s16] [s19] [s22] [s39] [s41]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Public illustrated international guide explains Slate account, credentials, referees, supplements, payment and
post-payment uploads. Finalized application information cannot normally be edited; supplementary
CV/documents can be uploaded after payment. No account opened or invitations sent in this research. [s5]

Math deadline/GRE rules are standing, not explicitly labeled Fall 2027. Central UDF is explicitly 2027-28;

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not waived, TOEFL taken after January 21, 2026: total4.5, reading/speaking≥4, listening/writing≥4.5; older

appear, but Math explicitly names TOEFL/IELTS, so confirm alternatives. Reports valid two years before entry;
do not infer Math accepts provisional English admission. [s1] [s6] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed regular US four-year bachelor's with most credits earned in the US qualifies for automatic
admissions waiver (not an online/experiential/overseas-branch degree). UChicago meets the institutional
setting; confirm handling while the BA is still in progress. A nonautomatic waiver is submitted by the
department. Admission waiver does NOT waive spoken-English TA certification: TOEFL speaking27/5.5, IELTS
speaking8, MSU Speaking Test50, or specified language-course plus oral-test route. [s6] [s9]

REQUIRED by both current department admissions page and FAQ; unofficial report initially, official if admitted;
five-year validity. No published Fall 2027 exception found. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]

strong mathematical evidence, such as advanced courses or research examples. Do not mistake optional for
indifferent. Five-year validity. [s1] [s2]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor's entry is compatible with the department's PhD route; complete the UChicago degree before
enrollment. University normally expects at least 3.0 in junior/senior undergraduate work. Math admits
internationally and only for fall; the ordinary Math/Applied Math MS is not a separate entry route. F-1 status is

upload the required documents and pay or arrange departmental payment. No prior supervisor agreement is
published. Check the English waiver before omitting a test. [s1] [s5] [s13]
